backend/main.mo: Defines an empty actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence metadata mapping features to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists concise summaries of all frontend files for quick reference.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles and OKLCH color variables for theming including light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting metadata, app icons, manifest link, and root mounting point.
frontend/public/site.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app name, icons, theme colors, and start URL.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling navigation state across all screens including the safety notice page.
frontend/src/components/GrownUpsGate.tsx: Empty file placeholder for grown-ups access gate component.
frontend/src/components/ScreenLayout.tsx: Reusable layout wrapper providing title, helper text, disclaimer logic, and safety notice link.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that initializes and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using react-query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and identity loading logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, custom color tokens, dark mode variants, base element styling, and custom animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdultMessagePage.tsx: Shows an alert message with gentle audio/vibration feedback and reveals encouragement before allowing completion.
frontend/src/pages/DailyFeelingsTrackerP: Lets users log daily feelings, view recent entries, and shows a brief success message after logging.
frontend/src/pages/EnergyCheckPage.tsx: Provides selectable energy levels with visual feedback via a pulsing star icon.
frontend/src/pages/FeelBetterPage.tsx: Displays a breathing animation and simple suggestions like drinking water and resting.
frontend/src/pages/FeelingConfirmationPa: Shows the selected feeling, gives safety guidance, and offers a large button to continue.
frontend/src/pages/FeelingsButtonPage.ts: Presents a grid of symptom buttons with icons for selecting a specific feeling.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/AboutPage.ts: Provides an About section explaining Luma, the app’s purpose, and includes footer attribution.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/ForParentsTe: Explains the app’s purpose for adults, how to use it with children, and important safety notes.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/GrownUpsArea: Offers grown‑up settings such as sound toggle, tracker reset, and links to informational pages.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/GrownUpsLock: Implements a two‑step grown‑ups lock using a press‑and‑hold timer followed by a simple math challenge before granting access.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/PrivacySafet: Renders privacy and safety information for adults, emphasizing no data collection and offline functionality.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/TeacherQuick: Provides guidance for teachers on how to introduce and use the app in classrooms, including usage steps and reminders.
frontend/src/pages/LocationPage.tsx: Asks the user to select their current location from three large button options.
frontend/src/pages/MenuPage.tsx: Renders the main menu with navigation buttons for feelings, energy check, tracker, feel-better, and grown‑ups access.
frontend/src/pages/SafetyNoticePage.tsx: Displays medical disclaimers, emergency guidance, and safe‑use information with a back button.
frontend/src/pages/SplashScreen.tsx: Shows a fading splash screen with a logo and auto‑navigates to the next step after a short delay.
frontend/src/pages/WelcomePage.tsx: Shows a welcome message with Luma and a single Start button to begin the app flow.
frontend/src/state/preferences.ts: Manages user preference storage in localStorage, currently only handling sound settings.
frontend/src/state/tracker.ts: Handles saving, retrieving, and resetting recent feeling‑tracking entries in localStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS with custom colors, animations, and app‑specific theme extensions.
project_state.json: Describes the project's state, active features, and pending requests related to safety, privacy, and UI text updates.
